description: Facility meal operations and deterministic paperwork, standalone or alongside ShorelineOps.

defaultPrompt: Check this weekly menu and tell me if it is ready.
interface.longDescription: Turn weekly menus and completed tallies into clear kitchen paperwork. Set up your facility, upload a redacted menu or count scan, review anything unclear, confirm, and print. Keep areas separate or combine their packets. Works locally with Codex, Claude Desktop and VS Code; the ChatGPT plugin uses a supported local executor. Export reviewed menus and counts into the ShorelineOps Paperwork tab. Free, published by CulinaryOS. Current menu adapter supports seven Sunday-Saturday days with breakfast, lunch and dinner A/B choices. Human confirmation is required. No resident database, clinical decisions, automatic prep rules, background notifications or live cross-app sync. Hosted ChatGPT execution is not included.

publication.release_notes: Clearer setup and help; exact ShorelineOps icon; repo-owned source; Codex/Claude Desktop/VS Code install packages and reviewed ShorelineOps transfer.
